info.name: Football Intelligence App API
info.description:
REST API collection for the Football Intelligence App FastAPI backend (ERD: db/football_intelligence_expanded.dbml, 47 resources). Every endpoint responds with the common envelope: { status, message, result, error }.

Run order: folders are ordered so a top-to-bottom run (Collection Runner / newman) satisfies every foreign key. Each 'Create' request stores the new id in a collection variable that later folders reuse; nothing is deleted until the final 'Cleanup' folder, which removes everything the run created in reverse dependency order. 'Validation Rules' holds negative tests for the domain rules (derived match result, lineup identity, date ordering, stat totals, enums, restrict-on-delete) and changes no data.

A collection-level pre-request script sets a random 'run_suffix' once per run, embedded in unique fields (role code, user email, season name, ...), so the collection can be re-run against the same persistent dataset without 409s. Saved examples were captured live against the mock dataset from scripts/generate_mock_data.py.
